defect.description: The setting is read as settings['FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE'] or False instead of settings.getbool(...): command-line overrides arrive as text, so -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False (or =0) gives the non-empty string 'False', which is truthy and turns active mode on.

review_items: feedstorage.py:27 — `or False` treats string 'False' from command line as truthy; use getbool
test only covers native bool True; missing string-path test
FTP connection not closed on exception (no with/try-finally)
votes.evidence_quote: `settings["FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE"] or False` does not convert string `"False"` from command-line overrides to a proper boolean. `"False" or False` evaluates to the truthy string `"False"`, so `-s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False` unexpectedly enables active mode.
votes.justification: The review identifies the exact cause at src/feedstorage.py: the setting is read with `or False`, so the command-line string 'False' is truthy and enables active mode. It also recommends getbool as the fix.
